name: Slack
free_plan_limits: 90 days of message history, up to 10 apps
best_for: Team chat with lots of app integrations
notes: Pro is $8.75 per user monthly or $7.25 yearly. Business+ is $18 monthly or $15 yearly. Free plan caps apps at 10, which limits bots. Bot and API terms not checked.

name: Telegram
free_plan_limits: Everything free; about 30 bulk messages a second
best_for: Free bots and alerts to your phone
notes: Bot platform is free for users and developers. Limits: about 1 message a second per chat, 20 a minute per group. Paid broadcasts need 100,000 Stars and 100,000 users.

name: WhatsApp Business
free_plan_limits: Business app free; replies to customers free for now
usage_note: Charged per message sent by the business, by type and country
since_note: WhatsApp Business app launched January 2018 (WhatsApp blog).
best_for: Messaging customers where they already are
notes: Priced: the API platform. Service replies are free now, but Meta says per-message charges start Oct 1, 2026 after 1,000 free a month. Marketing and utility messages cost per message.

name: Microsoft Teams
notes: Essentials $4 per user, billed yearly. Microsoft 365 Business Basic (includes Teams) is $7, though one licensing page says $6. Bot terms not checked.

name: Discord
free_plan_limits: Discord itself is free; Nitro is optional
best_for: Communities with bots and voice rooms
notes: Priced: free core app. Nitro Basic $2.99/mo and Nitro $9.99/mo are optional upgrades for users. Bot and API terms not confirmed from sources read.

name: Google Chat
since_note: First released as Hangouts Chat on 9 March 2017; renamed Google Chat in 2020 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Teams already using Gmail and Google Docs
notes: Priced: Google Workspace Business Starter, which includes Chat. $7 per user on the yearly plan, $8.40 month to month. Bot and API terms not checked.
